clauses.code: void read_input(int *H,int *W,char **S){ scanf("%d%d", H,W); *S=(char*)malloc((size_t)(*H)*(*W+1)); for(int i=0;i<*H;i++) scanf("%s", (*S)+i*(*W+1)); }
int idx(int r,int c,int W){ return r*W+c; }
int cell_value(char ch){ if(ch=='?') return 0; return ch-'0'; }
int check_fixed(char ch,int val){ int f=cell_value(ch); return (f==0 || f==val); }

clauses.signature: int can_place(int r,int c,int W,char *S,int *assign,int val)
clauses.code: int can_place(int r,int c,int W,char *S,int *assign,int val){ char ch=S[idx(r,c,W)]; if(!check_fixed(ch,val)) return 0; if(r>0 && assign[idx(r-1,c,W)]==val) return 0; if(c>0 && assign[idx(r,c-1,W)]==val) return 0; return 1; }
